content.text: Tracy uncovers a conspiracy involving Wendover, Tenney, and Boyce, then rushes from his mother’s farm to the Minster house, where he calms a threatened mob and wins public support. Jessica travels from the milliner’s shop to Tracy’s office, then the farmhouse, steals incriminating papers, and collapses at General Boyce’s home while trying to save Horace. She dies after reconciling Horace and Tracy. The text then recounts Louis XVI’s imprisonment in the Temple, trial before the Convention, execution, and the later executions of Marie Antoinette and Madame Elisabeth. The Dauphin dies imprisoned in the Temple; Madame Royale is released and later marries the Duc d’Angoulême. A separate story follows the Dashahed Zouaves’ camp and departure, while Winton’s young people form a club, tour local places, picnic, photograph the village, and plan further outings.
